_comment: RECONNAISSANCE - the whole region at 250 m in hours rather than days. Every unit fits in memory at this grid, including Xizang and Xinjiang, which 02 has to skip. Measured skill is much lower (spatial-block AUC 0.728 against 0.806 at 90 m and 0.816 at 30 m) because specific catchment area is resolution-sensitive by construction: use it to see the pattern and to plan, never as the deliverable.
